name: temper-flume-harness
description: flume control plane for building temper. The product is Rust (see Cargo.toml); this manifest exists only to run the build harness. It lives inside .flume/ so the engine↔pin handshake (flume ≥0.8) finds the provisioned install at <flumeDir>/node_modules — a pin in the repo-root package.json is a hard refusal under that handshake.
